queries.query: Managing PFAS residuals from membrane treatment. Prepare a focused review of how membrane-derived PFAS concentrates and spent membrane materials should be characterized and managed within a treatment train.
Determine how recovery, concentration factor, PFAS composition, and co-contaminants define the retained stream.
Compare downstream concentration, destruction, recycle, disposal, and hybrid-treatment options using compatible endpoints.
Assess how residual management changes the energy, cost, environmental burden, and practical value of membrane separation.
